le/asymptote/topology-r-spiral-covering-.note: A 3D figure: the desktop's asy (TeX Live's, which renders through a window) has no display here and writes a page of height 0 and a blank second page; Galley's asy draws the figure, its curves as vectors, on one page. With an asy built with OSMesa in place of the desktop's (pdfcompare.py's DESKTOP_ASY, PLAN task 17), the desktop's PDF equals Galley's (dev/pdfcompare-asy-osmesa.jsonl).

le/asymptote/torus-three-paths/torus-thr.note: A 3D figure: the desktop's asy (TeX Live's, which renders through a window) renders nothing without a display; Galley's renders the torus as a bitmap, as a desktop with a display does. With an asy built with OSMesa in place of the desktop's (pdfcompare.py's DESKTOP_ASY, PLAN task 17), the desktop's PDF equals Galley's (dev/pdfcompare-asy-osmesa.jsonl).

le/math/asymptote/sphere-sphere/sphere-s.note: A 3D figure (settings.render=0, vectors): the desktop page holds nothing but its page number, as TeX Live's asy finds no display here; Galley draws both spheres as vectors. With an asy built with OSMesa in place of the desktop's (pdfcompare.py's DESKTOP_ASY, PLAN task 17), the desktop's PDF equals Galley's (dev/pdfcompare-asy-osmesa.jsonl).

le/presentations/CNN-Intro/CNN-Intro.tex.note: Metropolis asks for Fira Sans. The desktop's fontconfig lists it but XeTeX cannot load it (T1/FiraSansLight(0) undefined), so the desktop falls back to Computer Modern serif; Galley has no Fira (texlive-fonts-extra is not shipped), says so, and keeps Latin Modern Sans.

le/documents/bachelor-proposal/bachelor-.note: Pixels equal. Debian ships its own build of Linux Libertine, whose opening quote has no Unicode mapping, so pdftotext reads nothing for it; Galley's TeX Live copy maps it.

le/uml/class-diagramm/class-diagram.tex.note: The figure meta.1 comes from running mpost on meta.mp, a step of the document's Makefile that neither latexmk nor Galley takes; both PDFs lack it, latexmk reports the error as a failure.
